message.content:
Set up a Python virtual environment for the ipython library at /app/ipython/.venv and install all dependencies. Steps:
1. Create the venv: python3 -m venv /app/ipython/.venv
2. Install the library: /app/ipython/.venv/bin/pip install -e /app/ipython
3. Install atheris: /app/ipython/.venv/bin/pip install atheris
4. Verify: /app/ipython/.venv/bin/python -c "from IPython.core.inputtransformer2 import TransformerManager; import atheris; print('ipython venv OK')"
